svg.title: Repository relationship matrix
svg.desc: A matrix of 11 shared layers against the 17 repositories. A filled cell means that repository uses that layer. The layers are model routing, deterministic fallback, grounding and citation, weighted scoring, vector retrieval, vision inference, audit trail and attestation, fastapi services, react front ends, container and cluster, simulate before shipping.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: A filled cell means the repository uses that layer. Read across for who shares a decision;
read down for what a system is made of.
